title: VERIFIER-AS-REWARD RFT -- EVAL + GATE (THE PIVOT, part 3; the DE-CONFOUNDED gate): poll exp4078's training; PER LADDER BASE, once its arms have usable checkpoints, EVAL each on the HELD-OUT ARC-induction split (disjoint from train) and report demo-perfect + true-gold induction rate for Arm A (RFT-correct), Arm B (RFT-ablation), Arm C (gold-SFT), the BASE's OWN cold rate (measured), and CODEX (~0.57 ceiling). THE LOAD-BEARING GATE is A vs B (the verifier-LABEL test): does RFT-CORRECT beat RFT-ABLATION on held-out induction with bootstrap CI95 excluding 0? If YES -> the verifier's LABEL carries training signal (verifier-as-reward is REAL, not codex-distillation). If A~=B -> 'RFT helps' is just codex-distillation; the verifier adds nothing (the honest null -- report it plainly, do NOT dress it as a win). SECONDARY: A vs C (does the label-free verifier signal match oracle labels -- A>=C?) and A vs cold base (any lift at all). ROBUSTNESS: report all three contrasts PER base; the headroom rung (Qwen3.5-0.8B) is PRIMARY; A>B holding ACROSS the ladder = robust. CAPACITY-FLOOR GUARD: a base whose cold rate is 0 is dropped as uninformative (NOT 'verifier fails'); if all bases floor, fall back to the Sudoku control + a tractable ARC subset. NOTE: decentralization-MAGNITUDE (close the gemma-4-12B 0.26->0.57 gap) is a .378 FOLLOW-ON. Honest null/small gain is a COMPLETE verdict; if still accumulating, report progress (NOT a retirement).
